# Jim Gabriel — Full Portfolio & App Dossier

> Tactile games & playful apps, built to own. Independent developer crafting expressive, touch-first games and interactive toys for iOS, iPadOS, and macOS — with Android releases on the way.

## Developer Overview

- **Developer**: James Gabriel (Jim Gabriel)
- **Website**: https://www.jimgabriel.com/
- **Apple App Store Developer Profile**: https://apps.apple.com/us/developer/james-louis-gabriel/id6833727433
- **Android Status**: Android versions are currently in development. More games and interactive apps coming soon.
- **Support & Contact Email**: jimgabriel2021@gmail.com

## Indie Philosophy

- **Pay Once, Own Forever**: Every release is a straightforward $0.99 one-time purchase. No subscriptions, no paywalls, and no in-app purchases.
- **Zero Ads, Zero Tracking**: No accounts required, no ad networks, and no personal data collected. Your apps stay cleanly on your device.
- **Built for Touch & Play**: Designed around tactile multitouch, responsive haptics, atmospheric sound, and offline play anywhere.

## Rock, Paper, Carnage

> Rock, paper, scissors with finishing moves.

- **Canonical Page**: https://www.jimgabriel.com/rock-paper-carnage/
- **App Store**: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/rock-paper-carnage/id6833727431
- **Android / Google Play**: Coming Soon
- **Category**: Game · Action / Arcade
- **Price**: $0.99 (One-time purchase · iOS & iPadOS · No ads · No IAP)
- **Platforms**: iOS, iPadOS
- **Minimum OS**: iOS / iPadOS 15.0+
- **Age Rating**: 12+ / 13+
- **Version**: 1.0
- **Release Date**: November 15, 2026
- **Plays Offline**: Yes
- **Official Trailer**: https://www.jimgabriel.com/assets/apps/rock-paper-carnage/trailer.mp4

### Overview

You were on your couch. Now you're a contestant on the galaxy's most violent game show, and the only thing you brought is your hand.

Rock, Paper, Carnage is rock, paper, scissors with finishing moves. Win the throw, punch in the combo before the clock runs out, and your hand turns into a boulder, a buzzsaw, a storm of paper cuts, and more. Miss it and the crowd boos. Lose the round and your opponent finishes you.

### Features

- **Read Your Opponent**: Every opponent has a tell — and most of the time it tells the truth. Spot it, throw what beats it, and earn that level's signature finisher.
- **Rhythm Showdowns**: Throw the same sign and your hands lock into a rhythm duel set to an original song. Win a showdown for a star; two stars unlock your Ultimate.
- **Eight Opponents, Eight Arenas**: Face a baby monkey under the circus big top, a toddler at daycare, an orangutan in the rainforest canopy, a coworker in the office break room, a bodybuilder at the beach gym, a silverback in the aquarium hall, the Galactic Warlord, and the Kraken.
- **Unlock More Carnage**: Earn points on the reward track to unlock finishers like the Wrecking Ball, the Guillotine, and the Meteor — plus blood styles from slime to confetti. Beat a boss to unlock Hard Mode.

### Highlights

- $0.99 one-time purchase — no ads, no in-app purchases
- Plays completely offline
- Built for touch with haptics on every press
- Universal iOS and iPadOS app

### Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: Where is my progress saved?**
All game progress is saved locally on your device. Deleting the app removes your saved progress.

**Q: Does the game require an internet connection?**
No. Rock, Paper, Carnage plays completely offline.

**Q: Are there ads or in-app purchases?**
No. It is a single $0.99 one-time purchase with zero ads and zero in-app purchases.

**Q: Why does iOS mention the camera or microphone in diagnostics?**
That reference comes from code bundled inside the game engine's video player. Rock, Paper, Carnage never accesses your camera or microphone.

### Privacy & Support

- **Privacy**: Rock, Paper, Carnage collects no personal data, requires no account, and contains no third-party ad or analytics trackers.
- **Support**: jimgabriel2021@gmail.com (https://www.jimgabriel.com/rock-paper-carnage/#support)

## Plasma Globe: Fidget Lamp

> A classic plasma ball under your fingers.

- **Canonical Page**: https://www.jimgabriel.com/plasma-globe/
- **App Store**: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/plasma-globe-fidget-lamp/id6835380705
- **Android / Google Play**: Coming Soon
- **Category**: Interactive · Fidget & Desk Lamp
- **Price**: $0.99 (One purchase covers iOS, iPadOS & macOS · No ads · No IAP)
- **Platforms**: iOS, iPadOS, macOS
- **Minimum OS**: iOS / iPadOS 17.0+ · macOS
- **Age Rating**: 4+
- **Version**: 1.0
- **Release Date**: November 18, 2026
- **Plays Offline**: Yes

### Overview

Plasma Globe puts a classic plasma ball under your fingers. Touch the glass and lightning leaps from the coil to meet you, one bolt for every finger.

Built to feel alive on a desk or in your hands, Plasma Globe pairs real multitouch lightning with responsive haptics, subtle tilt parallax, and rich night-room ambience. Leave it untouched and it settles into a calm, glowing desk lamp.

### Features

- **Real Multitouch Lightning**: Every finger draws its own crackling filament — up to five simultaneous bolts on iPhone and even more on iPad.
- **Tactile Haptics & Sound**: Feel a low electric hum and sharp snaps on iPhone as arcs jump to your fingertips, paired with reactive crackle and night-time ambience of crickets, crows, and the occasional cat.
- **Ten Colors & Spectrum Tube**: Pick from ten vivid lightning presets or sweep continuously across the spectrum tube to tune any wavelength.
- **Atmosphere & Desk Lamp Mode**: Tilt your device to peer around the glass sphere amid drifting fog, a swinging lamp, and moving shadows. The screen stays awake, settling into a calm glow when left untouched.

### Highlights

- One $0.99 purchase covers iOS, iPadOS, and macOS
- No accounts, no ads, and no data collected
- Screen-awake desk lamp mode for ambient lighting
- Tilt parallax and multitouch haptics

### Notices & Tips

- **Tip for iPad Users**: Four- and five-finger swipes belong to iPadOS system gestures. To rest your whole hand flat on the glass, disable them in Settings → Multitasking & Gestures.
- **Visual Sensitivity Note**: Contains flickering and flashing light effects.

### Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: Does one purchase work across all my Apple devices?**
Yes — a single $0.99 purchase unlocks Plasma Globe across iOS, iPadOS, and macOS.

**Q: Can I leave it running as a desk lamp?**
Yes. Plasma Globe keeps your screen awake and automatically settles into a calmer ambient glow whenever it's left untouched.

**Q: Does it require an account or internet connection?**
No accounts, no internet required, no ads, and zero data collection.

### Privacy & Support

- **Privacy**: Plasma Globe: Fidget Lamp requires no account, shows no ads, and collects zero personal data.
- **Support**: jimgabriel2021@gmail.com (https://www.jimgabriel.com/plasma-globe/#support)

## School Time!

> A living reef aquarium you can touch — and a timer you can watch.

- **Canonical Page**: https://www.jimgabriel.com/school-time/
- **App Store**: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/school-time/id6835664971
- **Android / Google Play**: Coming Soon
- **Category**: Interactive · Reef Timer & Aquarium
- **Price**: $0.99 (One-time purchase · iPad & macOS · No ads · No tracking)
- **Platforms**: iPad, macOS
- **Minimum OS**: iPadOS 18.0+ · macOS
- **Age Rating**: 4+
- **Version**: 1.0
- **Release Date**: November 18, 2026
- **Plays Offline**: Yes

### Overview

School Time is a living reef aquarium you can touch, and a timer you can watch.

Sixteen hundred golden fish swim as one across a sunlit coral reef. Lead them with a finger, split the school with two hands, or let them roam freely on a second screen. When it's time to focus, set any timer from 30 seconds to 2 hours and press HUNT — a pack of barracuda drops in and catches the fish at the exact pace of your countdown.

### Features

- **Lead 1,600 Golden Fish**: Touch the glass and the entire school follows your finger. Spread two fingers to split the school in two, bring them together to merge, or tap to startle them.
- **The Barracuda Countdown**: Set any timer from 0:30 to 2:00:00 and press HUNT. One glance tells you how much time remains: it's the size of the school. When the last fish disappears in a puff of bubbles, a buoy bell rings.
- **Four Living Reef Views**: Explore corals, sea fans, sponges, clownfish, tangs, parrotfish, and nautiluses from four camera perspectives — in the tank, gallery window, down the reef, or swimming with the school — each with pan and zoom.
- **Built for Focus & Everyday Timers**: Keeps ticking in the background with optional finish notifications, subtle sonar pings, pause/resume controls, and an automatic power saver for long sessions.

### Highlights

- Timers from 30 seconds to 2 hours with exact custom entry
- No blood or gore — caught fish vanish in a puff of bubbles
- Works offline with no accounts, no ads, and no tracking
- Great for focus sessions, study breaks, board games, or tea

### Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: Does the timer keep running if I lock my screen or switch apps?**
Yes. The timer stays accurate in the background and sends a notification when time is up if notifications are allowed.

**Q: Is it kid-friendly?**
Yes — rated 4+ with no blood or gore. When a barracuda catches a fish, it disappears in a puff of bubbles.

**Q: Can I just watch the aquarium without setting a timer?**
Absolutely. Lift your hand and the school roams naturally across the reef, making it great to leave running on an iPad or second screen.

### Privacy & Support

- **Privacy**: School Time! works completely offline, requires no account, displays no ads, and collects no personal data or tracking.
- **Support**: jimgabriel2021@gmail.com (https://www.jimgabriel.com/school-time/#support)
